metadata.title: Retail sales slump. Cheaper gas and an Amazon Prime hangover are the chief culprits. - MarketWatch

content.text:
Economic Report
Retail sales slump. Cheaper gas and an Amazon Prime hangover are the chief culprits.
Retail sales post largest decline in 14 months, but not because the economy is sputtering
The drop in sales in July was the biggest, not the first, in 14 months.
Sales at U.S. retailers in July had the largest decline in 14 months, but not because the economy sputtered. Americans spent less at gas stations due to cheaper fuel and bought less online after Amazon’s summer sales bonanza.
